ownership_reason: Only the gold decides which element's text is the document's title: it visits the document's elements in document order and takes the text of the element with the title tag name. Hops 1, 3 and 4 pass the full element list (documented as the elements of a document, in document order) and the lower-case tag name along, and hop 2 only trims the gold's result. A document's title element is the first title element in document order (HTML); the variant keeps visiting after the title element and returns the text of the last title-named element, so on a document with two title elements it returns the second one's text. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the intact setter Document.title(String) updates getElementsByTag("title").first(), the element the getter must read back; Element.getElementById returns the first match in document order (elements.get(0)); Document.head() and body() take .first(). ElementTest::testGetElementById (the first match in document order) and ElementTest::getElementsByTagName (matches listed in document order) pass, as do ParserTest::createsDocumentStructure and ParseTest::testYahooJp through the chain (one title element).
